subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which public Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation peer routing without breaking existing account bindings?
rationale: The bug needs peer-shaped Feishu conversation bindings, but this PR changes a documented CLI/config contract and there are multiple competing candidate PR shapes.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add peer support
options.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` semantics intact and add either explicit peer syntax or narrowly validated Feishu conversation-id detection with docs and tests.

options.title: Accept Feishu reinterpretation
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally make `feishu:<value>` mean group peer, but the PR needs docs, upgrade guidance, and proof that account users have a safe path.

options.title: Adopt another candidate PR
options.body: Pause this branch and select another open Feishu-bind candidate if its syntax and proof better preserve compatibility.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add peer support
recommendation.body: Keep `<channel>:<account>` semantics intact and add either explicit peer syntax or narrowly validated Feishu conversation-id detection with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision centers on the account-scoped bind command surface introduced in the account binding work.
